description: Implement one authoritative numerical core for exact valuation, component accounting and shared-pool allocation. The native library and CLI must work without a language wrapper, table engine, simulator or cloud account.

verification.scope: Exact point-date kernel/CLI, deterministic allocation, independent installed CLI and bounded performance verified. Automatic segmentation and full project-licence/release qualification remain open. The 14 November increment adds bounded 0.2 incomplete instrument-capacity semantics and five synthetic genomics candidates; original 0.1 digests remain unchanged. See the separate increment evidence; broader provider and economic qualification remains open.

completion_evidence: All supported exact reference cases match independently derived results; invalid quantity/unit/date/valuation combinations return structured errors.
Allocated pool values plus explicit residuals equal source pools; duplicate resource and loaded-component charges are detected or rejected under the declared policy.
The CLI preserves exact numeric transport, immutable source selection and complete/incomplete result status.
Synthetic 2.50 weighted units at 17.00 per unit produce 42.50 in the declared funding view without manufacturing resource-use records.
Repeated native runs reproduce the agreed output digest after excluding explicitly non-semantic metadata; no implicit current date or network selection changes results.
The minimal feature build runs without Arrow/Polars, ontology, simulation, GPU or web-service dependencies.
